query:
SELECT
                        record AS "record: Json<WakeRecord>",
                        received_at,
                        trace_updated_at,
                        started_at,
                        wake_id
                    FROM agent_wakes
                    WHERE agent_user_id = $1
                      AND status = $2
                      AND (started_at, wake_id)
                          < (COALESCE($3::timestamptz, 'infinity'), COALESCE($4::text, ''))
                    ORDER BY started_at DESC, wake_id DESC
                    LIMIT $5
